title: Session ids are validated at every boundary
content: SECURITY CONSTRAINT: session ids are validated by ValidSessionID (2..64 chars, ASCII letters/digits/hyphens) at EVERY handler boundary, and the store's Get returns ErrInvalidID for invalid ids. Established on /session. New lookup paths (admin variants etc.) MUST reuse ValidSessionID and ErrInvalidID; hand-rolled validation or skipped checks are a security review blocker.
